project.name: Campus Connect
project.description: Campus event management platform where students can discover, organize and register for events

qa.question: What is the name of your project?
Describe the project and what it should do.
qa.answer: Campus event management platform where students can discover, organize and register for events

qa.question: What type of website is it?
Who will use it? (e.g. customers, admin)
List the main features you need (comma separated).
qa.answer: User registration/login page, Browse and search events, create/manage events, admin dashboard, email notifications, reccomendations for events

qa.question: Which of those features are must-have for the first launch?
qa.answer: User registration and login, browse and search events, event registration

qa.question: Any outside services needed? (payments, email, maps...)
qa.answer: Email notifications | Users should be notified when the event is approaching, capacity being filled of an event , remidner

qa.question: Any technology or framework preference? (e.g. Django)

objectives: Enhance student engagement by providing a centralized platform for event discovery and registration.
Streamline event management processes for students and administrators.
Facilitate communication and notifications regarding events to improve attendance.
Create a user-friendly interface that encourages regular use among university students.
Establish a scalable platform that can accommodate future enhancements and increased user load.

functional_requirements.text: Ability to browse and search for events based on various criteria.
Functionality for users to create and manage events.
Admin dashboard for managing events and users.
Email notifications for event reminders and updates.
Recommendations for events based on user preferences.

performance: Page load time should be under 3 seconds.
System should handle at least 1000 concurrent users.
security: User data must be encrypted in transit and at rest.
scalability: System architecture should support horizontal scaling.
Database should handle increased load without performance degradation.
reliability: System uptime should be 99.9% or higher.
Backup and recovery processes must be in place.
usability: User interface should be intuitive and require no more than 3 clicks to register for an event.
Provide accessibility features to support users with disabilities.

out: Advanced analytics dashboard for event organizers
Social media integration for event sharing

risks.risk: Potential delays in development due to tight deadline.
risks.mitigation: Implement agile methodologies and prioritize must-have features.

risks.risk: User adoption may be lower than expected.
risks.mitigation: Conduct user testing and gather feedback to improve usability.
Conduct regular security audits and implement best practices.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the registration page
acceptance_criteria.when: I enter valid registration details and submit the form
acceptance_criteria.then: I should receive a confirmation email and be redirected to the login page

acceptance_criteria.when: I enter my valid credentials and click the login button
acceptance_criteria.then: I should be logged in and redirected to my account dashboard

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Failed user login with invalid credentials
acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the login page
acceptance_criteria.when: I enter invalid credentials and click the login button
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see an error message indicating invalid credentials

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the events page
acceptance_criteria.when: I do not apply any filters and click the browse button
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see a list of all available events

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the events page
acceptance_criteria.when: I enter a keyword in the search bar and click search
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see a list of events that match the keyword

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the events page
acceptance_criteria.when: I select a date range and click apply filters
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see a list of events occurring within the selected date range

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in and viewing an event
acceptance_criteria.when: I click the register button for the event
acceptance_criteria.then: I should receive a confirmation message and see the event in my registered events list

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Failed event registration due to full capacity
acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in and viewing a fully booked event
acceptance_criteria.when: I click the register button for the event
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see a message indicating that the event is fully booked

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in as an event organizer
acceptance_criteria.when: I fill in the event details and click the create event button
acceptance_criteria.then: The event should be created and appear in my events list

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in as an event organizer and have an existing event
acceptance_criteria.when: I update the event details and click the save button
acceptance_criteria.then: The event should be updated with the new details

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in as an admin user
acceptance_criteria.when: I navigate to the admin dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see the admin dashboard with options to manage events and users

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Manage user accounts from admin dashboard
acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the admin dashboard
acceptance_criteria.when: I select a user account to manage
acceptance_criteria.then: I should be able to view and edit the user's details

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Receive email notifications for event updates
acceptance_criteria.given: I am registered for an event and have opted in for notifications
acceptance_criteria.then: I should receive an email notification about the updates

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in and have attended events in the past
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see a list of recommended events based on my preferences
